'''2022 Regional Championships''' were the Players Committee regional constructed events in 2022.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-06-2022-regional-championship-events/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' various
* '''Dates:''' 14 May – 5 November 2022
